finished.title: Scrub finished
finished.body: Pool {pool} was checked. {errors, plural, =0 {No errors found.} one {# error found.} other {# errors found.}}

warm.title: Disk getting warm
warm.body: Disk {disk} in {pool} reports {temperature, number} °C. Check the airflow.

poolDegraded.title: Pool {pool} is degraded
poolDegraded.body: A disk of {pool} failed or is missing. Your data is still there, but one more failure could lose it. Replace the disk soon.

poolFaulted.title: Pool {pool} is not available
poolFaulted.body: {pool} reports {state}. Its data cannot be reached until the missing disks are back.

dataErrors.title: Damaged files in {pool}
dataErrors.body: {errors, plural, one {# file has} other {# files have}} errors that ZFS could not repair. Restore {errors, plural, one {it} other {them}} from a backup.

scrubErrors.title: Scrub found errors in {pool}
scrubErrors.body: The last scrub of {pool} found {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}. Check the health of its disks.

capacityWarning.title: Pool {pool} is filling up
capacityWarning.body: {pool} is {percent, number} % full. Above 80 % ZFS gets slower; free some space or add disks.

capacityCritical.title: Pool {pool} is almost full
capacityCritical.body: {pool} is {percent, number} % full. Free some space soon, or writes will fail.

smartFailed.title: Disk {disk} is failing
smartFailed.body: Disk {disk} (serial {serial}) predicts its own failure. Make sure your data is backed up and replace the disk now.

smartWarning.title: Disk {disk} shows wear
smartWarning.body: Disk {disk} (serial {serial}) reports {reallocated, number} reallocated, {pending, number} pending and {uncorrectable, number} uncorrectable sectors and {mediaErrors, number} media errors{selfTest, select, failed {; its last self-test failed} other {}}. Plan to replace it.

poolSuspended.title: Pool {pool} has stopped
poolSuspended.body: Too many disks of {pool} are gone, so ZFS stopped all reads and writes to protect the data. Connect the disks again: Pithyx resumes the pool on its own. Other pools keep working; do not destroy or export this one until then.

diskMissing.title: Disk {disk} of {pool} is not connected
diskMissing.body: Disk {disk} disappeared from {pool}. If it was unplugged by mistake, connect it again: Pithyx adds it back and ZFS copies what it missed. Otherwise replace it.

poolLocked.title: Pool {pool} is locked
poolLocked.body: {pool} waits for its key. Its shared folders, home folders and apps are unavailable until an administrator unlocks it in Settings > Storage.

poolLockedVault.title: Pool {pool} could not be unlocked
poolLockedVault.body: The key in the key vault did not unlock {pool}. Its data is untouched, but its shared folders, home folders and apps are unavailable until an administrator unlocks it in Settings > Storage with the stored key.

poolLockedUsb.title: Pool {pool} waits for its USB stick
poolLockedUsb.body: Plug in the USB stick {stick} with the key of {pool}, or unlock it in Settings > Storage with the stored key. Until then its shared folders, home folders and apps are unavailable.

poolLockedUsbFailed.title: Pool {pool} could not be unlocked from the USB stick
poolLockedUsbFailed.body: The key file on the USB stick did not unlock {pool}: it holds an older key or is damaged. Its data is untouched. Unlock it in Settings > Storage with the stored key, then write the key to the stick again.

unlocked.title: Pool {pool} unlocked from a USB stick
unlocked.body: The key on {stick} unlocked {pool}. You can pull the stick now and keep it safe: {pool} stays unlocked until the box restarts, and then needs the stick again.

missing.title: A device of {app} is missing
missing.body: {app} needs {path}, which is not plugged in. Its background service does not run until the device is back.

critical.title: {app} has root access now
critical.body: {user} granted {app} the right {right}: the app can now control the whole box. If you did not expect that, revoke it in Settings > Security.

restoreSkipped.title: Some windows were not restored
restoreSkipped.body: {count, plural, one {# window belongs} other {# windows belong}} to an app that is no longer available.

copied.title: Desktop loaded
copied.body: The windows from {device} are now open here.

saveFailed.title: Window arrangement not saved
saveFailed.body: The daemon did not save the layout of this desktop. Your windows stay open.

restoreFailed.title: Saved windows not loaded
restoreFailed.body: The daemon did not answer. Changes to this desktop are not saved until you reload the page.

noteKept.title: Note text kept
noteKept.body: {count, plural, one {A note was changed on another device while you wrote on it. Your text is on a new note next to it.} other {# notes were changed on another device while you wrote on them. Your texts are on new notes next to them.}}

cancelled.title: {kind}: cancelled
cancelled.body: The task was stopped before it finished.

interrupted.title: {kind}: interrupted
interrupted.body: The system restarted while the task ran. Start it again if it is still needed.

available.title: App updates
available.body: {count, plural, one {A newer version is ready: {apps}.} other {# newer versions are ready: {apps}.}}

available.title: Pithyx {version} is available
available.body: This box has {installed}. Settings > Updates shows what changes.

available.title: Debian updates
available.body: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}}, {security, plural, one {# of them a security fix} other {# of them security fixes}}. Install them in Settings > Updates.

installed.title: Pithyx {version} installed
installed.body: The update passed its health check.

rolled_back.title: Update to {version} failed
rolled_back.body: Pithyx {restored} is back{reason, select, null {.} other { (failed check: {reason}).}}

restored.title: Pithyx {version} restored
restored.body: The system went back to the snapshot. Settings changed since then are lost.

changed.title: The update source is now {name}
changed.body: {official, select, true {The box follows the Pithyx project again and trusts only its keys.} other {Switched in the recovery menu: the box reads its updates from {url} and trusts only the keys of {name}. If nobody here did this, switch back in the recovery menu.}}

degraded.title: A system disk is missing
degraded.body: The {array, select, system {system} other {swap}} mirror runs on {working} of {expected} disks. The box keeps running; replace the disk soon.

on_battery.title: The UPS runs on battery
on_battery.body: {charge, select, null {The power failed.} other {The power failed; the battery is at {charge} %.}} The box shuts down at the limit set in Settings > UPS.

online.title: The power is back
online.body: The UPS runs on line power again{charge, select, null {.} other {; the battery is at {charge} %.}}

shutdown.title: The box shuts down for the UPS
shutdown.body: {reason, select, forced {The UPS's NUT server shuts every system down.} low_battery {The UPS says its battery is low.} charge {The battery reached the charge limit.} runtime {The battery reached the runtime limit.} lost {The UPS ran on battery and stopped answering.} other {The UPS is about to run out.}} Shares and apps stop now.

unreachable.title: The UPS does not answer
unreachable.body: {problem, select, refused {No NUT server answers.} timeout {The NUT server does not answer in time.} unknown_ups {The NUT server has no UPS of that name.} driver_not_connected {No UPS was found, or its driver failed.} data_stale {The UPS stopped sending data.} access_denied {The user or password is wrong.} other {The NUT server answered with an error.}} Without it, the box cannot shut down cleanly on a power failure.

blocked.title: Repeated failed sign-ins
blocked.body: {user, select, null {Somebody at {address} failed to sign in {failures} times within {minutes} minutes and has to wait.} other {Somebody at {address} failed to sign in as {user} {failures} times within {minutes} minutes and has to wait.}}

test.title: Test notification
test.body: If you read this, the channel {name} works.

test.title: Test email
test.body: If you read this, the box can send email through {host}.

renewal_failed.title: Certificate of {name} not renewed
renewal_failed.body: Let's Encrypt did not renew it. Settings > Reverse proxy shows why; the box tries again later, and the current certificate stays until it ends.
